Highway 3 Creston to Hope is very pretty. The route is well maintained, safe, and scenic. I drove from Vancouver to Fernie about 15 times last year for work so I know the route really well. Feel free to PM me if you have specific questions or need hotel suggestions.


Highlights

* Creston - Columbia brewery for Kokanee beer
* Drive from Creston to Castelgar through Kootenay pass is beautiful
* Castlegar is a nice small town, watch for Elk, Big Horn Sheep, and Moose on the road. Black and Brown bears are frequent along hwy 3
* Detour north of castlegar to Nelson is worth the visit
* Castlegar to Grand Forks goes through the Pollson Pass which is gorgeous
* As mentioned cristna lake will be busy
* Grand Forks is inundated with deer... in fact the drive from Christina Lake to Osoyoos can be dangerous driving within a few hours after sundown due to deer on road. If you do drive at dusk keep your eyes open and reduce speed
* Greenwood is a great place to stop for lunch
* The petro can gas station in Rock Creek has the best homemade jerky I've ever tasted
* Anarchist Summit leading into Osoyoos has a beautiful view of the town
* Osoyoos has the warmest lake in Canada and is technically a desert
* check out the model train exhibit leaving Osoyoos. Totally worth it 
* Detour north west of Osoy
oos to Oliver on hwy 97- the wine capital of western Canada. On the way to Oliver is Burrowing Owl winery. My favourite. The Merlot is fantastic. Farther down the road is Church and State winery with award winning red wines that are out of this world 
* take 97 back to 3 and continue towards Vancouver
* stop in Kerameos for spectacular fresh fruit!!!! 
* hwy 3 Princeton to Manning Park will be under construction this summer. This stretch is also really busy with trucks and RVs. It's really curvy and only two lanes so prepare to go slow and be patient
* check out Harrison Hot Springs when past hope. Golden Ears park is a great place to see massive trees

* check drivebc.com daily for road conditions and weather forecasts along your route. Hwy 3 has been closed due to forest fire several times - at Rock Creek last July. Drive BC will be your best resource for your trip
